ja: 会議の前に私たちで接続テストをしておけば、音声トラブルであんなに時間を無駄にしなかったのに。
en: If we had tested the connection before the meeting, we wouldn't have wasted so much time on audio problems.
alternatives: If we'd done a connection test before the meeting, we wouldn't have lost so much time to audio issues.
We wouldn't have wasted so much time on audio problems if we had tested the connection before the meeting.
point: 過去の仮定は if + had 過去分詞、帰結は wouldn't have 過去分詞

ja: 通話中ずっと途切れていたのは、回線じゃなくてそちらの音声だったんですよ。
en: It was your audio, not the connection, that kept cutting out during the call.
alternatives: What kept cutting out during the call was your audio, not the connection.
It was your audio that kept cutting out during the call, not the connection.
point: 強調したい語を It was と that で挟む

ja: 私が転送ボタンを押したときには、お客様はもう電話を切ってしまっていました。
en: By the time I pressed the transfer button, the customer had already hung up.
alternatives: When I pressed the transfer button, the customer had already hung up.
The customer had already hung up by the time I hit the transfer button.
point: 先に起きた「切った」は had hung up、hang の過去分詞は hung

ja: 会議のリンクはどこにありますか？
en: Where is the meeting link?
alternatives: Where can I find the meeting link?
Where's the link for the meeting?
point: Where の後は is the link の語順にする

ja: 私の画面、みなさん見えますか？
en: Can everyone see my screen?
alternatives: Is my screen visible to everyone?
Can you all see my screen?
point: 「見えますか」は can see で表す。are seeing としない

ja: 受付の方は、田中さんは会議中なので30分後にかけ直してもらえないかと言っていました。
en: The receptionist said Mr. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked if I could call back in thirty minutes.
alternatives: The receptionist told me Mr. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked me to call back in thirty minutes.
The receptionist said Ms. Tanaka was in a meeting and asked if I could call back in half an hour.
point: said に合わせて is を was、can を could にずらす

ja: 昨日の会議ではそちらの音声が何度も途切れていましたが、あれから別のヘッドセットに替えましたか？
en: Your audio kept cutting out in yesterday's meeting. Have you switched to a different headset since then?
alternatives: Your audio kept dropping out in yesterday's meeting. Have you gotten a different headset since then?
Your audio kept breaking up in yesterday's meeting. Have you switched to another headset since then?
point: 昨日の出来事は過去形、あれからの変化は現在完了

ja: 回線が悪いので、カメラをオフにしてもいいですか？
en: My connection is bad, so can I turn off my camera?
alternatives: Can I turn off my camera? My connection is bad.
May I turn my camera off? My connection is poor.
point: 許可を求めるのは Can I 〜? で、Can you と取り違えない

ja: 雑音が入っているので、話さないときはマイクをミュートにしたほうがいいですよ。
en: There's some background noise, so you should mute your mic when you're not talking.
alternatives: We're getting some background noise, so you should mute yourself when you're not speaking.
There's some noise coming through, so you should mute your mic when you aren't talking.
point: 「〜したほうがいい」は you should で、had better は強すぎる

ja: すみません、今おっしゃったことが聞き取れませんでした。
en: Sorry, I didn't catch what you just said.
alternatives: Sorry, I couldn't catch what you just said.
Sorry, I didn't hear what you just said.
point: 「おっしゃったこと」は what you said で表す

ja: 彼、会議の前にマイクの設定を確認しておけばよかったって言ってたよ。
en: He said he wished he had checked his mic settings before the meeting.
alternatives: He said he should have checked his mic settings before the meeting.
He told me he wished he'd checked his microphone settings before the meeting.
point: 過去への後悔は wish + had 過去分詞、checked のままにしない

ja: 田中さん、マイクがミュートになっていますよ。もう一度言ってください。
en: Mr. Tanaka, you're on mute. Please say that again.
alternatives: Mr. Tanaka, you're muted. Please say it again.
Mr. Tanaka, you're on mute. Could you say that again?
point: ミュート中は you're on mute が定番の言い方

ja: 私の声が途切れたら、チャットで教えてください。
en: If my voice cuts out, please let me know in the chat.
alternatives: Please let me know in the chat if my voice cuts out.
If my voice breaks up, please tell me in the chat.
point: 未来のことでも if 節は現在形 cuts out にする

ja: 部長がいつ会議から戻るか、分かりますか？
en: Do you know when the manager will be back from the meeting?
alternatives: Do you know what time the manager will be back from the meeting?
Do you have any idea when the manager will be back from the meeting?
point: 間接疑問は when the manager will be の語順にする

ja: お客様からのお電話は、もう営業部に転送されましたよ。
en: The customer's call has already been transferred to the sales department.
alternatives: The customer's call has already been put through to the sales department.
The customer's call was already transferred to the sales team.
point: 「転送された」は has been transferred と受動態で

ja: すみません、今は運転中なので、あとでかけ直します。
en: Sorry, I'm driving now. I'll call back later.
alternatives: Sorry, I'm driving right now, so I'll call you back later.
Sorry, I'm driving right now. I'll call you later.
point: 今している最中のことは I'm driving と進行形で言う

ja: この回線、少し雑音がありますね。
en: There's some noise on this line.
alternatives: There's a little noise on this line.
There is some noise on the line.
point: 「雑音がある」は There's some noise で、noise は数えない

ja: すみません、もう少しゆっくり話していただけますか？
en: Sorry, could you speak a little more slowly?
alternatives: Sorry, could you talk a little more slowly?
Sorry, would you mind speaking a bit more slowly?
point: slow ではなく副詞 slowly を比較級 more slowly にする

ja: ここ 10 分くらい、そちらの映像がずっと止まったり動いたりしていますよ。
en: Your video has been freezing on and off for about ten minutes.
alternatives: Your video's been freezing on and off for the last ten minutes or so.
Your video's been cutting in and out for about ten minutes.
point: 続いている状態は has been freezing と現在完了進行形

ja: 山田さんが、この通話にあなたにも入ってほしいそうです。
en: Yamada wants you to join this call too.
alternatives: Yamada would like you to join this call too.
Yamada wants you on this call too.
point: want you to join の形。want that you と言わない

ja: たとえ映像を切ることになっても、音声さえ安定していれば、今日の打ち合わせはこのまま続けられますよ。
en: Even if we have to turn off our video, we can still carry on with today's meeting as long as the audio holds up.
alternatives: Even if we need to switch off the video, we can keep going with today's meeting as long as the audio stays stable.
We can continue today's meeting even if we have to turn our cameras off, as long as the audio is stable.
point: 「たとえ〜しても」は even if、「〜さえ安定していれば」は as long as
